question: When the litmus solution is neither acidic nor basic then its colour is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**purple**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The natural colour of litmus is purple.
 
• When the litmus solution is neither acidic nor basic then its colour is **purple**.
 
• Litmus paper is used as one of the chemical indicators.
 
• It is used to determine whether a solution is acidic or basic.
 
• If the blue litmus paper is put in an acidic solution, it turns red.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A Litmus paper test is done** to find the solution whether it is** Acidic or Basic in nature.**
 
• Litmus paper is a type of** pH paper** made by treating paper with natural dyes from lichens.
 
• The blue litmus paper turns red or pink when it comes into contact with an acidic solution below** a pH of 4.5**
 
• **It becomes purple if the pH of the solution is between 4.5 and 8.3 and if the pH is above 8.3 it stays blue.**
 
• The solution which is Basic in nature having a pH range between **8.5 and 14 changes the colour of red litmus paper to blue.**
